name: agent-verifier
tagline: An independent guardian in front of every agent send().
description: Pre-send verification for outbound agents. A small, separate control that sits in front of send() and gives every message (email, social, helpdesk reply) an independent verdict across deterministic gates — calendar block, confidential-term redlist, regex — plus an optional LLM semantic check that decomposes the body into atomic claims and grades each verified/unverifiable/failed. Worst-axis-wins; every verdict is logged as a per-message audit artefact. Python 3.10+ stdlib only, bring your own LLM.
